name: Velvet Matte Lip
shortDescription: A soft-focus, weightless lip colour in rosewood.
description: A modern matte with the comfort of a balm. Velvet Matte Lip melts across the lips with buildable pigment and a softly blurred finish that wears beautifully from afternoon tea to after dark.

name: Silk Skin Tint
shortDescription: Sheer, breathable coverage with a lit-from-within finish.
description: Your skin, refined. This breathable tint smooths the look of tone and texture while leaving the natural dimension of your skin visible. Infused with squalane for a fresh, satin finish.

name: Radiance Ritual Oil
shortDescription: A botanical facial oil for rested, luminous skin.
description: A concentrated evening ritual of rosehip, camellia and marula oils. Press two drops into clean skin to seal in hydration and wake to a complexion that feels deeply replenished.

name: Cloud Cleanse
shortDescription: A cushiony cream cleanser for a calm, clean start.
description: A generous cream cleanser that lifts the day away without taking your comfort with it. Oat, calendula and glycerin leave skin soft, balanced and ready for the next step.

name: Silk Press Mist
shortDescription: Weightless shine and heat protection for polished lengths.
description: A fine, non-sticky mist that protects against styling heat while smoothing flyaways and adding glassy shine. Finished with a quiet citrus and cedar accord.

name: Afterglow Body Cream
shortDescription: A rich, fast-absorbing cream with a soft amber veil.
description: A plush body cream made for the final, unhurried step. Shea butter and niacinamide comfort dry skin while a veil of amber, iris and sandalwood stays close to the skin.

name: Atelier Pouch
shortDescription: A structured cotton pouch for the essentials you carry.
description: Cut from sturdy cotton canvas and lined in wipe-clean satin, the Atelier Pouch keeps the small things considered. A polished brass zip and generous shape make it an everyday essential.

name: Soft Focus Blush
shortDescription: A sheer cream blush for a just-pinched flush.
description: The fingertip-friendly cream blush that belongs in every morning routine. It blends in seconds and leaves cheeks with a believable, softly radiant flush.
